readings: Inner join fees to orders (fees.orderslink = orders.recordvault) and to users (orders.userlink = users.userstamp), dropping unmatched fees. Compute AVG(feerate), ignoring NULLs, for each (orderslink, acctscope) pair. Take the mean of all these pair averages across all pairs and scopes. Keep only pairs whose average is strictly above that mean, and compute excess = pair average minus that mean. Within each acctscope, rank pairs by excess descending using standard RANK, so tied pairs share a rank and the next rank is skipped. Return the pairs with rank <= 3, which can be more than 3 per scope when there are ties. Show orderslink, acctscope, average feerate, excess and rank, all unrounded.

Inner join fees to orders (fees.orderslink = orders.recordvault) and to users (orders.userlink = users.userstamp), dropping unmatched fees. Compute AVG(feerate), ignoring NULLs, for each (orderslink, acctscope) pair. Take the mean of all these pair averages across all pairs and scopes. Keep only pairs whose average is strictly above that mean, and compute excess = pair average minus that mean. Within each acctscope, assign a strictly sequential rank (ROW_NUMBER) by excess descending, breaking ties by orderslink ascending. Return exactly the top 3 pairs per scope (fewer if the scope has fewer qualifying pairs). Show orderslink, acctscope, average feerate, excess and rank, all unrounded.

Inner join fees to orders (fees.orderslink = orders.recordvault) and to users (orders.userlink = users.userstamp), dropping unmatched fees. Compute AVG(feerate), ignoring NULLs, for each (orderslink, acctscope) pair. Take the mean of all these pair averages across all pairs and scopes. Keep only pairs whose average is strictly above that mean, and compute excess = pair average minus that mean. Within each acctscope, rank pairs by excess descending using DENSE_RANK, so tied pairs share a rank and no ranks are skipped. Return the pairs with dense rank <= 3, which can be more than 3 per scope when there are ties. Show orderslink, acctscope, average feerate, excess and rank, all unrounded.
queries:
WITH pair_avg AS (
  SELECT f.orderslink AS orderslink, u.acctscope AS acctscope, AVG(f.feerate) AS avg_feerate
  FROM fees f
  JOIN orders o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault
  JOIN users u ON o.userlink = u.userstamp
  GROUP BY f.orderslink, u.acctscope
),
overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_feerate) AS mean_avg FROM pair_avg
),
above AS (
  SELECT p.orderslink, p.acctscope, p.avg_feerate, p.avg_feerate - o.mean_avg AS excess
  FROM pair_avg p
  CROSS JOIN overall o
  WHERE p.avg_feerate > o.mean_avg
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT orderslink, acctscope, avg_feerate, excess,
         RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY acctscope ORDER BY excess DESC) AS rnk
  FROM above
)
SELECT orderslink, acctscope, avg_feerate, excess, rnk
FROM ranked
WHERE rnk <= 3;
WITH pair_avg AS (
  SELECT f.orderslink AS orderslink, u.acctscope AS acctscope, AVG(f.feerate) AS avg_feerate
  FROM fees f
  JOIN orders o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault
  JOIN users u ON o.userlink = u.userstamp
  GROUP BY f.orderslink, u.acctscope
),
overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_feerate) AS mean_avg FROM pair_avg
),
qualified AS (
  SELECT p.orderslink, p.acctscope, p.avg_feerate, p.avg_feerate - o.mean_avg AS excess
  FROM pair_avg p CROSS JOIN overall o
  WHERE p.avg_feerate > o.mean_avg
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT orderslink, acctscope, avg_feerate, excess,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY acctscope ORDER BY excess DESC, orderslink ASC) AS rank
  FROM qualified
)
SELECT orderslink, acctscope, avg_feerate, excess, rank
FROM ranked
WHERE rank <= 3
ORDER BY acctscope, rank;
WITH pair_avg AS (
  SELECT f.orderslink AS orderslink,
         u.acctscope AS acctscope,
         AVG(f.feerate) AS avg_feerate
  FROM fees f
  INNER JOIN orders o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault
  INNER JOIN users u ON o.userlink = u.userstamp
  GROUP BY f.orderslink, u.acctscope
),
overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_feerate) AS mean_avg
  FROM pair_avg
),
above AS (
  SELECT p.orderslink,
         p.acctscope,
         p.avg_feerate,
         p.avg_feerate - o.mean_avg AS excess
  FROM pair_avg p
  CROSS JOIN overall o
  WHERE p.avg_feerate > o.mean_avg
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT orderslink,
         acctscope,
         avg_feerate,
         excess,
         DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY acctscope ORDER BY excess DESC) AS rnk
  FROM above
)
SELECT orderslink, acctscope, avg_feerate, excess, rnk
FROM ranked
WHERE rnk <= 3;
